label: JUMA DUA
line1: Ae hamare Rab, hamein duniya mein bhi bhalai de,
line2: aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai, aur hamein aag ke azaab se bacha.
author: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:201

label: SABR
line1: Ae imaan walo, sabr aur namaz se madad lo,
line2: beshak Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.
author: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:153
